title: When using  "Show only tasks > From the current screen", Task Manager doesn't show open windows after monitor-related changes (plug/unplug, scale change)
line: After docking and closing the lid, a task manager showing only the current screen's tasks now lists the windows on that screen instead of none.
explanation: The task manager compares each window's screen with its containment's screenGeometry, which the shell refreshes when the desktop view sees its screen move. While docking, the desktop window's screen briefly flips back to the laptop output, and ContainmentView::reactToScreenChange() then disconnected every signal from the old screen to the view, including DesktopView's own geometryChanged connection. When the lid closes and the dock output moves to 0,0, the containment keeps the old position and the filter hides every window. A second, older issue (from the earlier r39 fix) made window screens go stale when screens were added or removed, so after undocking the dock's task manager still listed windows that had moved to the laptop. ContainmentView now drops only its own connection, and libtaskmanager re-evaluates window screens when screens come and go.

commits.message:
ContainmentView: Only drop our own connection when the screen changes

Changing screens dropped every connection from the old screen to the
view, including the desktop view's own, so a later move of that screen
never reached its containment. Now only our own connection is dropped.

BUG: 520961

libtaskmanager: Recompute window screens when screens come and go

The screen of each window was refreshed when a screen changed geometry
but not when one was added or removed, so after re-docking a window kept
its old screen and was listed in the task manager of the wrong screen.

BUG: 520961

patches.diff:
From f6db33040c7efb5ca0787c442ddbbbf452550c8b Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 17:32:55 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] ContainmentView: Only drop our own connection when the screen
 changes

Changing screens dropped every connection from the old screen to the
view, including the desktop view's own, so a later move of that screen
never reached its containment. Now only our own connection is dropped.

BUG: 520961
---
 src/plasmaquick/containmentview.cpp | 2 +-
 1 file changed, 1 insertion(+), 1 deletion(-)

diff --git a/src/plasmaquick/containmentview.cpp b/src/plasmaquick/containmentview.cpp
index 3e8daee6f..0cc59ba1a 100644
--- a/src/plasmaquick/containmentview.cpp
+++ b/src/plasmaquick/containmentview.cpp
@@ -199,7 +199,7 @@ void ContainmentViewPrivate::reactToScreenChange()
         return;
     }
 
-    QObject::disconnect(lastScreen, nullptr, q, nullptr);
+    QObject::disconnect(lastScreen, &QScreen::geometryChanged, q, &ContainmentView::screenGeometryChanged);
     lastScreen = newScreen;
     QObject::connect(newScreen, &QScreen::geometryChanged, q,
                      &ContainmentView::screenGeometryChanged);
--

media.caption: Master: dock panel after 4 dock + lid-close cycles. Konsole and Dolphin are on that screen but only launchers show.
Fixed: same 4 cycles, Konsole and Dolphin are listed (Dolphin active) every time.
Master: after reopening the lid the windows move to the laptop screen, but the dock panel still lists them.
Fixed: the dock panel no longer lists windows that moved to the laptop screen.
